## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` when extension/Webview behavior changes
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a regression test

## Public-data and documentation checks

- [ ] No proprietary measurement, customer, wafer, local-path, or PDK data is included
- [ ] Touchstone fixtures are synthetic and minimal
- [ ] README/CHANGELOG documentation is updated when behavior changes
- [ ] New dependencies or extension/Webview message-boundary changes are explained
